Class CartesianPoint

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.math.BasePoint<Double>
com.j3d.engine.math.CartesianPoint
public final class CartesianPoint extends BasePoint<Double>
CartesianPoint, not to be confused with ScreenPoint, represents a point in 2D space. (On the Cartesian AxisPlane, where (0, 0) is the centre of the window.)

All 2d points should be calculated in CartesianPoint, but when you want to show it on the screen, converted to a ScreenPoint
